merge into T_GDYY_BIG_ROLL_COLOR a USING (
select #{STOCK.bigRollCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} big_roll_code, #{STOCK.colorType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} color_type, #{STOCK.colorCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} color_code, #{STOCK.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} status, #{STOCK.createBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} create_by, #{STOCK.createTime,jdbcType=DATE} create_time, #{STOCK.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} remark from dual
) b ON (a.big_roll_code = b.big_roll_code) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.status = b.status, a.color_type = b.color_type, a.color_code = b.color_code,
a.update_by = b.create_by, a.update_time = sysdate, a.remark = b.remark WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (a.id, a.big_roll_code, a.color_type, a.color_code,a.status, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.remark, a.del_flag) values (SEQ_PUBLIC.NEXTVAL, b.big_roll_code, b.color_type, b.color_code, b.status, b.create_by, sysdate, b.remark, '0')
